content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The official notification details the total vacancies and monthly remuneration but does not explicitly list the detailed educational qualifications, age limits, or experience requirements inside the summary table.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The positions are offered on a contract or outsourcing basis under the National Health Mission (NHM) in Mancherial district. The consolidated monthly remuneration ranges from Rs. 17,500 to Rs. 1,00,000 depending on the specific designation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DMHO Mancherial Lab Technician
content_sections.text: Obtain the application details and notification from the official website. Fill out the offline application form with all required details. Submit the filled applications in person or through the designated submission mode at the office of the District Medical and Health Office, Integrated District Offices Complex (I.D.O.C.), Mancherial. Ensure applications are submitted between the start date of 13-10-2026 and the last date of 16-10-2026 by 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates must attach all relevant educational, technical qualification, and experience documents as specified by the district authorities along with the offline application form.
